patches.reason: dsh-think-translate 1.2.5 renders pre-0.1.7 icon exports (IconThinkOutline16 and friends), which resolve to null on 0.1.7, so the settings glyph and the row chevrons silently disappear. It also predates the turn-process seat. This profile carries the fix as a file: vendor with a guard script; declaring it here is what makes the drift visible, and the guard script only checksums. The pin is the version in the vendored package.json — if the profile reports this bundle by its file: specifier instead, match what the page shows.
